bullets.title: NVDA: Product roadmap intact despite delay noise; Anthropic/AWS demand strong
bullets.body: Multiple sources confirm NVDA roadmap is intact per staff meetings and Morgan Stanley NDR takeaways. Vera Rubin on track for Q3 launch; Kyber NVL144 rack delayed to 2028 due to PCB midplane issue. Anthropic's share of compute on NVDA chips rose to nearly 50% per MS NDR disclosure. Jensen Huang cited three demand growth vectors: AI labs (20% of demand), hyperscalers (50%), and AI clouds/industrial/enterprise (fastest growing). NVDA trading near 10-year low fwd P/E at 10% discount to S&P500; Citi maintains Buy at $300 PT.

bullets.title: META: Muse Spark 1.1 launches, 14GW compute plan + neocloud ambitions drive major re-rating
bullets.body: Meta released Muse Spark 1.1 (frontier-class model at $1.25/$4.25 per million tokens), announced 14GW compute target by 2027 and its Iris AI chip entering production in September. META also exploring renting excess compute to third parties. States are seeking $1.4T in penalties over addictive design, and EU found DSA breach on Instagram/Facebook. KeyBanc raises PT to $790 (OW), Mizuho upgrades, stock up ~19% in July with ETH data showing META trading +4.5% pre-market Monday.

bullets.title: MU: $250B US capex plan, Q3 massive beat; memory supercycle thesis validated
bullets.body: Micron raises US investment to $250B through 2035 (vs. prior $200B) and poured first concrete at NY fab. Q3 EPS $25.11 beat consensus by 20%; Q4 guide $50B ±$1B, 14.7% above consensus; gross margins 84.9%. SK Hynix CEO warns 2027 will be worst memory supply year in industry history, with demand to outpace supply into next decade. JPM's Harlan Sur raises CoWoS estimates and notes DRAM contracts up 20-30% QoQ in Q3; WFE forecasts lifted 23% to $1T through 2030. MU described as 4-5x peak earnings by one MS analyst.

bullets.title: AVGO: $30B+ Apple deal through 2031 signals multi-year custom silicon ramp
bullets.body: Apple and Broadcom announced a $30B+ multiyear agreement through 2031 for custom silicon and wireless components, producing 15B+ US-made chips with $1.5B Colorado facility expansion. Analysts note Apple's custom AI datacenter ASIC ramp could be material by 2029/2030. Wolfe Research hosts AVGO CEO/CFO virtual meeting; management sounded bullish on closing full 20GW XPV financing by FY28 with unconstrained demand double 2027 levels. AVGO expanded to include new Apple AI/datacenter XPU accelerator and RF content.

bullets.title: META/GOOGL/AMZN hyperscaler capex raised again; AI infra demand durable
bullets.body: GS raises GOOGL capex to $189bn 2026 and $275bn 2027; AMZN AWS revenue forecast raised to +32% YoY 2Q. AMZN issued $25B bond sale for AI capex—fourth raise YTD totaling $53B. JPM downgrades MSFT and META credit (not equity) on capex funding risks; upgrades ORCL credit. Citi CIO survey shows IT budget growth accelerating to +3.3%, with AI as top priority; MSFT, AMZN, GOOGL lead in AI spend increases. KeyBanc raises GOOGL PT to $445 on durable Cloud/Search momentum.

bullets.title: TSM: Raised to NT$3100; CoWoS capacity lifted 4th time in 2026; Q3 guide to beat
bullets.body: JPM raises TSMC Jun-27 PT to NT$3100 (20x forward), FY26/27/28 EPS up 5%/10%/16%. Jefferies bullish, expects 3Q guide +10-12% QoQ. Arizona Phase 1 GM already ~50% with 90% yield, much faster than expected. Demand-supply gap widened to ~20% on agentic AI CPU surge; CoWoS capacity estimates raised for 4th time in 2026 to 115k/190k/225k wfpm. TSMC wafer pricing hikes of 10%+ expected in 2027 across advanced nodes.

bullets.title: NFLX: Engagement concerns; exploring live TV and bundles ahead of 7/16 print
bullets.body: JPM maintains OW at $118 PT; expects 2Q inline with guidance on pricing, subs, and ad revenue. Engagement growth anemic at +2% YoY in 1Q; Netflix's US viewership fell to 7.8% of total TV time—lowest since May 2025. Company exploring always-on live TV channels and Peacock bundle as mitigation. NFLX exploring 2030/2034 World Cup bids. Bears flagging multiple compression risk; Citi cuts PT to $100, maintains Buy.

bullets.title: WULF: $19B 20-yr Anthropic lease at Justified campus is record 'time to power' deal
bullets.body: TeraWulf signed 20-year lease with Anthropic at Justified Data Campus in Kentucky, generating ~$19B contracted revenue at 401MW capacity, coming online H2 2027. Implied annual rent of $197/kW/month exceeds Citi's $150 estimate. WULF monetized 50.1% Abernathy JV stake to Fluidstack for $530M at premium. Citi raised PT to $36 and maintains Buy; Morgan Stanley raises PT to $72 from $66.50 on stronger time-to-power premium.

bullets.title: AAPL: EU DMA gatekeeper ruling upheld; tariff exemption via AVGO deal; $300+ PT on price elasticity
bullets.body: EU General Court dismissed Apple's challenge to gatekeeper designation, forcing App Store and iOS openness. Apple secured semiconductor tariff exemption in exchange for committing to manufacture chips at Intel fabs. JPM raises AAPL PT to $345 on price elasticity resilience—FY27 EPS maintained at $9.85 despite ~20% avg hardware price increases. Hedgeye initiates AAPL as a new short with $313 entry, 23% downside target. Apple testing CXMT DRAM for China devices.

bullets.title: SHOP/FIG: Dual upgrades at Stifel and BofA ahead of earnings season
bullets.body: Stifel upgrades SHOP to buy, raises PT to $150 from $110. BofA reinstates FIG at Buy with $30 PT (29% upside). Multiple analysts flag SHOP as preferred internet application pick going into Q2. Figma insider Jason Calacanis noted buying 100 shares at the dip in public posts.

bullets.title: CIEN/LITE/COHR/AAOI: Optical sector oversold; Rosenblatt says short sellers have no conviction
bullets.body: Rosenblatt states short sellers in photonics lack conviction and plan to cover before earnings. CIEN: Raymond James raises PT to Street-high (FY28 bull case $20 vs Street $14), $50B TAM by 2029. Lumentum (LITE) flagged InP capacity as next AI infrastructure bottleneck; analyst notes LITE has flagged InP capacity expansion on calls. AAOI: Rosenblatt counters B. Riley short thesis on AMZN/OpenAI network optimization impact; photo sector down 1-2 months on CPO delay fears viewed as excessive.

bullets.title: DIS: Free tier for Disney+ under discussion; sky acquisition of ITV M&E negative for CMCSA
bullets.body: Disney is exploring a free-tier option for Disney+, per multiple sources including Business Insider and Citi. Sky (CMCSA unit) agreed to buy ITV's M&E business for $2.1B; CMCSA stock declined on the news. NFLX, Sony, and YouTube are competing with Fox for 2030/2034 World Cup broadcast rights, adding competitive pressure.

bullets.title: CRM: KeyBanc downgrades to Sector Weight on weak Agentforce adoption and CIO checks
bullets.body: KeyBanc downgrades Salesforce from Overweight to Sector Weight; removes price target. Weak customer checks and CIO surveys show CRM as standout for wrong reasons—more CIOs planning to deprioritize vs. prioritize. Core issue: customer data not organized for meaningful AI work, delaying Agentforce utility. Street consensus requires acceleration that checks do not yet confirm.

bullets.title: PSKY/WBD: States may sue to block deal; Arete downgrades to Sell at $2 PT
bullets.body: Reuters reports California and other states may file antitrust suit to block Paramount Skydance's acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery next week. Oregon AG still probing deal; Oregon is seeking documents on Trump admin lobbying. Arete Research downgrades PSKY to Sell with $2 PT implying 79% downside; deal carries ~$80B debt load post-merger. Deal closing date pushed to July 22.

bullets.title: TSLA: SpaceX-Tesla combination strategically coherent per JPM; Miami robotaxi launches
bullets.body: JPM published a note finding a SpaceX-Tesla combination 'strategically coherent' due to shared engineering talent, AI infrastructure, and Terafab facility in Texas—but flags regulatory hurdles (China exposure, voting asymmetry, SPCX $2.2T > TSLA $1.4T valuation). Tesla launched unsupervised robotaxi service in Miami, its first non-Texas market. TSLA operating ~59 robotaxis vs 577 autonomous taxis across all competitors combined in Texas.

bullets.title: AMD: Initiated market perform at William Blair; B300 outperforms B200 on vLLM benchmarks
bullets.body: William Blair initiates AMD at market perform (Sebastien Naji). One source reports NVIDIA B300 faster than B200 on vLLM Kimi model architecture. AMD engineers re-prioritizing vLLM optimization after ROCm support removal. AMD 2027 CoWoS unchanged at 240K despite 2026 booking trims; 1.5M MI400 GPU shipments expected.

bullets.title: HOOD: Agentic Trading accounts surpass 70K; Robinhood Chain sees $633M DEX volume
bullets.body: Robinhood reports 70,000+ Agentic Trading accounts opened since May launch, expanding to crypto. Robinhood Chain shows $633M DEX volume and 306.5K daily active users. CEO Vlad Tenev promotes Trump Accounts. Multiple sources describe HOOD as a potential 'credible first global brokerage hyperscaler'; Mizuho maintains Outperform with $130 PT.

bullets.title: Geopolitical risk: US-Iran strikes escalate; Strait of Hormuz traffic declines
bullets.body: US launched third round of strikes on Iran in a week; Iran retaliated attacking US military sites in Kuwait and Bahrain. Iran declared Strait of Hormuz closed 'until further notice' though Trump and CENTCOM confirmed commercial shipping continues. UBS daily data shows Hormuz tanker traffic declining; IEA warns escalation could disrupt oil surplus forecast. Oil spiked to $78-80/bbl intraday before moderating. Normalization of Hormuz traffic not expected before December per one analyst.

bullets.title: AAPL: Sues OpenAI over alleged trade secret theft; OpenAI hired 400+ Apple engineers
bullets.body: Apple filed a federal lawsuit against OpenAI alleging misappropriation of trade secrets by former employees Chang Liu and Tang Yew Tan (OpenAI's Chief Hardware Officer). Apple claims OpenAI solicited confidential hardware materials from job candidates. Apple says OpenAI has now hired 400+ people from Apple. OpenAI device launch in February faces Apple legal headwinds per The Information.
